item.title: [7.3] Yen slips ahead of central bank bonanza, dollar firms on tech rebound
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Yen vs Dollar : The Japanese yen fell against the US dollar as market sentiment shifted towards risk-taking. A rise in Japan's service-sector inflation suggests increasing price pressures that may lead to future interest rate hikes.

WHY IT MATTERS

Previewing a major central bank decision week with currency movements driven by inflation and fiscal concerns is relevant for global market positioning.
